data.body: RED oracle contract: authoritative contract is this ticket's current-history-preference and recorded-SHA fallback ACs, grounded in the disposable rewrite rehearsal. Production path is the real verify-identity CLI over a real temporary tickets Git history. The rewrite case will prove a compacted ledger has non-null old SHAs, rewrite every reachable commit while preserving the exact tip tree, prove each event position resolves to a different current SHA, and require the gate to remain verified. The contrast/fallback case will use an unresolvable current position plus a reachable recorded pre-key SHA and require key-not-valid-at-era, proving the recorded SHA—not a null anchor—is retained. Tier: real-Git subprocess integration in the focused unit module; one tier lower cannot exercise ancestry or history resolution. Gate: the exact pytest nodes under make test. Collateral invariants: ledger schema/event bytes and live-event behavior remain covered by existing tests.
